obernants.domain: All u64 triples paired with Result<u64,ZeroModulus> observations.
obernants.operator: U consists of all input triples paired with Err or Ok(u64). U minus R contains Ok when m=0, Err when m>0, and Ok(r) with m>0 but r>=m or wrong power congruence. Exact mathematical target, bounded-tested.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Conditional relation with bounded evidence; no universal proof.
obernants.assumptions: Standard Rust arithmetic and oracle, ordinary terminating execution.

obernants.domain: All u64 triples paired with Result<u64,ZeroModulus> observations.
obernants.operator: Err admits exactly m=0 triples. Ok(r) admits all triples with m>r and b^e congruent to r mod m. Different bases/exponents/moduli retain ambiguity; e=0 restricts r=1%m and m=1 permits all b,e with r=0.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Conditional relation with bounded evidence; no universal proof.
obernants.assumptions: Standard Rust arithmetic and oracle, ordinary terminating execution.

obernants.domain: All u64 triples paired with Result<u64,ZeroModulus> observations.
obernants.operator: For m>0, P(b,e,m)=P(b%m,e,m); changing a base by a multiple of m is valid only if it fits u64. Fixed-seed tests exercise reduction.

obernants.domain: All u64 triples paired with Result<u64,ZeroModulus> observations.
obernants.operator: For m>0 and a+c fitting u64, P(x,a+c,m)=P(x,a,m)*P(x,c,m) mod m. Tests use a,c<=31 and widened products.

obernants.domain: All u64 triples paired with Result<u64,ZeroModulus> observations.
obernants.operator: P(x,0,m)=1%m. For m>1, P(m-1,e,m)=1 for even e and m-1 for odd e. Explicit (-2)^3 mod u64::MAX probes accumulator multiplication overflow.
